title: typha angustifolia subsp. domingensis
intro: Typha angustifolia subsp. domingensis, commonly known as Dominican bulrush, is a subspecies of Typha angustifolia, a type of sedge or cattail plant that grows in wetland areas. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, colds, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Dominican bulrush include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help to soothe irritated tissues and promote the healing process. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
